subject.title: fix(slack): prefer native status by default

question: Should unset Slack status reactions be suppressed only when a native status thread is available, or should top-level `replyToMode: off` messages intentionally fall back to static acknowledgement only?
rationale: The source-level regression is clear, but the permanent default affects existing Slack UX and compatibility, so maintainer intent is needed if the PR wants to accept static-only progress for unthreaded paths.

options.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
options.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually call Slack.

options.title: Accept Static Ack Default
options.body: Merge the stricter default only if maintainers intentionally accept losing lifecycle progress reactions for unthreaded Slack paths and update docs to say so.

options.title: Pause For Slack Progress Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Slack progress/status UX policy settles which surface owns progress feedback.

recommendation.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually call Slack.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete is the most recent owner of the touched Slack status path and this PR carries the protected maintainer label.
